items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows for arbitrary code execution due to unrestricted file upload. It has been actively exploited in the wild to breach e-commerce stores.

items.title: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability (Broccoli2Shell/HTTP2Shell/Node2Shell)
items.summary: An unchecked return value vulnerability in Google Brotli, which can be used with Adobe Commerce, could lead to remote unauthenticated attackers corrupting memory, disclosing sensitive information, causing denial-of-service, or executing arbitrary code. This vulnerability has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849, a critical template engine injection flaw (BlockStrap) with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe recommends applying this manual patch immediately.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical security update resolves a vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) that could result in arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce (SessionReaper)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in all versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento, dubbed 'SessionReaper,' allows for customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks exploiting this flaw have been observed globally.
